purpose: E cell under the usable tier: give the axon an initiation site (Stage A), then move the count and gain one boundary at a time (Stage B). Specification: docs/specs/2026-09-07-h01-usable-circuit-plan.md; levers from docs/evidence/h01-z-map-e.md.
holdout: Sweep 55 is sealed (h01-l2-reserved-input.json) and is not an input of any stage; sweep 53 is open (spent) and may be used as a second input for a finalist.
evaluation: One parameter set at sweep 50 without current probes; the axon voltage probe is always recorded.

A.title: Initiation site: transient sodium inserted in the axon stub
A.prediction: Axon (axon[1](0.5)) crosses -20 mV before the soma in both arms. Somatic shoulder: a local dV/dt maximum of 100 to 300 V/s between -55 and -45 mV before the main rise. Threshold moves from -52 toward -56 mV. a-axon-na (soma sodium 1.3): main rise within 15 percent of 641 V/s, peak within 2 mV of 36; a-axon-na-soma065: main rise below 550 V/s, peak 28 to 36 mV, threshold near -55, count 5 +/- 1 at sweep 50, trough within 1 mV of -69.5.
A.rejection: No shoulder and no axon-first crossing in either arm: the 60 um stub at 1 um diameter cannot host initiation; the initial-segment geometry is returned as a family change beyond this cap. A shoulder without an axon-first crossing is recorded as a partial result and Stage B proceeds on the candidate.
A.unchanged: Allen 541563728 geometry and mechanisms, recorded command and bias, nseg x9, CVode 1e-10, stop 2100 ms, library kv3-closing-source; the axon reversal potentials are the soma's (53, -107).

B.title: Count and gain, one boundary per arm, on the Stage A survivor or the candidate
B.prediction: b-sk-half: late cycles shorten by a third or more, count 6 to 7 at sweep 50 (human 5, usable rate limit 15 percent: the rate row may fail high), AHP unchanged within 1 mV. b-ca-decay (1.0 against 1.33): cycles shorten 10 to 20 percent, count 5 to 6. b-leak-rev (-2 against -4): threshold reached sooner, count +1, AHP 1 mV shallower. Any arm that changes width by more than 0.2 ms or AHP by more than 2 mV is a regression.
B.rejection: No arm moves the mean cycle by more than the human cyclical spread (the retained table's range times 1.47): the count is not set by the Modulate boundary or the supply reaching threshold; report and stop.
B.unchanged: As Stage A; every arm carries the Stage A survivor's flags (somatic sodium 0.9, axonal NaTs 3.814) with one boundary changed. Stage B0 (separate manifest h01-e-usable-b0-manifest.json) ran the survivor at sweep 53 first.

A2.title: Initiation site, somatic sodium between the two Stage A arms
A2.prediction: a-axon-na-soma09 (axonal NaTs 3.814, somatic sodium 0.9): axon first; threshold -57 +/- 1 mV; upstroke slope profile within 30 V/s of the human at -52 to -42 mV; main rise 600 to 750 V/s; peak 37 to 40 mV; first minimum -70 to -73 mV; no depolarisation block: at least 4 spikes with late cycles 250 to 350 ms; time above -20 mV 0.9 to 1.1 ms.
A2.rejection: Block, or main rise above 800 V/s, or fewer than 4 spikes: the somatic density is not a monotone lever between the arms; Stage B proceeds on a-axon-na.
